note: RockSim cluster imports now survive RockSim's own rounding quirks (the reported 12in Darkstar's 6x75mm ring imports as a real 6-motor cluster around its central 98mm mount); the batch dialog gets a mount picker so you can batch the cluster ring while the central mount keeps its motor (this also surfaces the mixed 3+3 option on 6-motor clusters); and a new eject button in the vitals strip unloads all motors in one click to view the rocket clean.
